title: Rethinking Langevin Thompson Sampling from A Stochastic Approximation Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2510.05023v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Langevin-based Thompson Sampling (TS) methods for multi-armed bandits use likelihood gradients to approximate posterior samples when exact sampling is intractable. As new rewards arrive, the posterior changes, and these methods run an inner Markov chain to approximate the updated target. To simplify this repeated sampling procedure, we introduce TS-SA, which incorporates stochastic approximation (SA) within the TS framework. In each round, TS-SA takes one Langevin step using the newly observed reward and applies an SA update to combine the noisy proposal with the current parameter estimate. By retaining this estimate across rounds, TS-SA maintains one continuing Markov chain for each arm, preserving the influence of past observations without storing or sampling them again. translated_title: 从随机近似视角重新思考朗之万汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 基于朗之万的汤普森采样（TS）方法用于多臂老虎机问题，在精确采样难以实现时，利用似然梯度来近似后验样本。随着新奖励的到来，后验分布会发生变化，这类方法需要运行一条内部马尔可夫链来逼近更新后的目标分布。为了简化这种重复采样过程，我们提出了TS-SA，它将随机近似（SA）引入TS框架之中。在每一轮中，TS-SA利用新观测到的奖励执行一步朗之万更新，并通过一次SA更新将含噪的提议与当前参数估计相结合。通过在各轮之间保留该参数估计，TS-SA为每个臂维护一条持续的马尔可夫链，在无需存储或重新采样历史观测的情况下保留了过去观测的影响。在这一递归过程中，提议步长在各轮之间保持固定，而SA权重则随观测不断累积而逐渐递减，以控制……
tldr: TS-SA将随机近似（SA）融入朗之万汤普森采样框架，每轮仅用新观测奖励执行一步朗之万更新并结合递减的SA权重，为每个臂维持一条持续的马尔可夫链，从而无需存储或重复采样历史观测即可高效逼近变化的后验分布。
en_tdlr: TS-SA incorporates stochastic approximation into Langevin Thompson Sampling, taking a single Langevin step per round with the newly observed reward while maintaining one continuing Markov chain per arm, enabling efficient posterior approximation without storing or re-sampling past observations.
